terms.comment: Our working expression for source code; no claim of established major-source usage. fontālis, fontāle — pertaining to a source, a post-Classical adjective; fōns, fontis m. — source or spring. The noun’s nominative ō is long before ns; it is not mechanically carried into fontis.

sources: Lewis & Short: codex · Lewis & Short: fons · Morgan–Owens: Silva
